papers.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
papers.summary: TokenGate is a lightweight learnable token-pruning module that accelerates long-context prefill in transformers by selectively skipping unimportant tokens via token-gated attention.

papers.title: Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution
papers.summary: Harness-Delta Attribution dissects harness evolution gains into overfitting, test-time scaling, and residual generalizable improvement, finding that most search-set gains do not reliably transfer to held-out tasks.

papers.title: Vision as Proprioception: Estimating Humanoid Robot Pose from Video
papers.summary: HumanoidPose recovers full-body humanoid robot joint configurations from video by combining human-pose features with robot kinematics and self-training on unlabeled videos.

papers.title: A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation
papers.summary: LILIE uses an invertible normalizing-flow encoder to derive language-informed supervision for text-to-image generation, improving fidelity over pixel-only training.

papers.title: First Passage Attention
papers.summary: First Passage Attention replaces monotonic decay accumulation with path extrema to selectively retain older context, enabling perfect long-range retrieval with compressed caches.
